title: 第7章 双生暗争第8章 商会阴谋
lines: “封存。”
长夏把黑羽信符压在黑钢桌面，铁指环划过纸面。信符边缘立刻生出一圈铁灰符文，把残留黑星火锁在里面。
他没有急着看坐标，先取出一枚铁卫密钥，插进信符中央。
黑羽一根根散开，露出三行记录。
星纹学院医疗廊。
初级宿舍区。
洛晖徽章，第一枚星痕碎片，七日备案持有期。
长夏把纸面转向暗鹰队长。
“暗影教给的饵，先验毒。”
暗鹰队长取出银针，针尖触到黑羽残纹，银针前端立刻变黑。他后退半步，把针丢进铅盒。
长夏抬手按住信符，铁灰符文继续收缩，黑色残火被压成一枚小点。
“少主有私心，情报是真的。”
暗鹰队长低头：“是否进学院抓人？”
长夏把洛晖宿舍位置圈住，又在旁边写下三个词：平民派，绮氏，显曜。
“不动他。”
暗鹰队长抬头。
长夏把铁指环压在洛晖名字上。
“他刚击败雷昂，学院里盯着他的人比钟塔上的鸦还多。抓走一个洛晖，只能得到一块碎片。放他走几步，谁靠近星痕，谁反对血统垄断，谁想借他翻盘，名单会自己长出来。”
暗鹰队长把学院布局图铺开。
长夏拿起红笔，在外墙、旧钟塔、星纹排水渠、初级宿舍外侧逐一点下。
“学院安全巡检，赛后护卫备案，铁卫城防协查。三层名义，三套节点。不得越过教授席权限，不得碰学院核心阵。”
“洛晖有星火冲击，近距离监视会暴露。”
长夏拿起一枚医疗晶片，放在桌面。
“别盯人，盯回声。赛后补给，医疗晶片，宿舍登记牌，凡是他星痕波动经过的地方，都会留下余纹。暗鹰印记藏进物资外层，不接触他的星纹，只记余波。”
暗鹰队长接过晶片。
“目标？”
长夏翻开名单。
第一行：贝莎。
第二行：雷昂。
第三行：绮兰侍从。
“先动他身边的人。别让他知道刀从哪边来。”
暗鹰队长收起名单，退入密门。
长夏留在桌前，又把信符拆成四份。
一份归铁卫档案。
一份送暗鹰。
一份改成假情报，投给贵族派。
最后一份，他用赤金封蜡盖住。
“送去赤金商会曜都账房。告诉他们，洛晖的碎片还在七日备案期内，转让漏洞没关。”
密探从暗门后伸手接过封蜡信。
长夏指节在桌面点了两下。
“商人闻到金子，比猎犬闻血还勤快。让他们先敲门。”
content_en:
"Sealed."
Chang Xia pressed the black feather letter talisman on the black steel table, and the iron ring crossed the paper. A circle of iron-gray runes immediately appeared on the edge of the letter talisman, locking the remaining black spark inside.
He did not rush to look at the coordinates, but first took out an Iron Guard key and inserted it into the center of the talisman.
The black feathers spread out one by one, revealing three lines of records.
Xingwei Academy Medical Gallery.
Junior dormitory area.
Luo Hui badge, the first star mark fragment, has a seven-day registration and holding period.
Chang Xia turned the paper to Captain Dark Eagle.
"The bait taught by Shadow must be tested for poison first."
Captain Dark Eagle took out the silver needle. When the tip of the needle touched the black feather pattern, the tip of the silver needle immediately turned black. He took a half step back and dropped the needle into the lead box.
Chang Xia raised his hand and pressed the letter talisman. The iron gray rune continued to shrink, and the black residual fire was pressed into a small dot.
"Young Master has selfish motives, the information is true."
Captain Dark Eagle lowered his head: "Are you going to the academy to arrest someone?"
Chang Xia circled the location of Luo Hui's dormitory and wrote three words next to it: civilian faction, Qishi, Xian Yao.
"Don't move him."
Captain Darkhawk looked up.
Changxia pressed the iron ring on Luo Hui's name.
"He just defeated Leon, and there are more people staring at him in the academy than the crows on the clock tower. If you capture Luo Hui, you can only get a fragment. Let him walk a few steps. Whoever gets close to Xinghen, who opposes the bloodline monopoly, whoever wants to use him to make a comeback, the list will grow on its own."
Captain Dark Eagle laid out the layout of the academy.
Chang Xia picked up the red pen and clicked on the outer wall, the old clock tower, the star pattern drainage channel, and the outside of the junior dormitory one by one.
"College security inspection, post-match security filing, Iron Guard city defense and inspection. Three layers of names, three sets of nodes. Do not exceed the authority of the professor's seat, and do not touch the core formation of the college."
"Luo Hui has a spark attack, and close surveillance will expose him."
Changxia picked up a medical chip and placed it on the table.
"Don't keep an eye on people, keep an eye on Echo. Post-match supplies, medical chips, dormitory registration tags, wherever his star marks pass through, they will leave traces. The Dark Eagle mark is hidden in the outer layer of the supplies, and does not touch his star marks. Only the aftermath will be recorded."
Captain Dark Eagle took the chip.
"Target?"
Chang Xia opened the list.
First row: Bertha.
Second row: Leon.
Third row: Attendant Qilan.
"Tool the people around him first. Don't let him know where the knife came from."
Captain Dark Eagle put away the list and retreated into the secret door.
Chang Xia stayed at the table and broke the letter into four parts.
A file belonging to the Iron Guard.
Get one copy for Dark Eagle.
One piece of information was changed into false information and voted to the noble faction.
For the last portion, he covered it with red gold sealing wax.
"Send it to the Yaodu Accounting Office of the Chijin Chamber of Commerce. Tell them that Luo Hui's fragments are still within the seven-day filing period and the transfer loophole is not closed."
The spy reached out from behind the secret door and took the wax-sealed letter.
Chang Xia tapped her knuckles twice on the table.
"A merchant smells gold faster than a hound smells blood. Let them knock first."
